statement:
∀ (N : ℕ) (c : ℤ → ℂ),
  ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-↑N) ↑N,
    ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-↑N) ↑N, c k * cexp (↑k * ↑t * I)) * cexp (-(↑n * ↑t * I)) = 2 * ↑π * c n
